FILE_STRUCTURE             REQUIRED  -     ASCII tree of the module directory plus a File Mapping list.

MODULE_DECISION_LOG        OPTIONAL  FOLD  One-line summary of recorded decisions; full <ACR>-DL-N entries per DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT fold under <details>.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
HANDOFF                    REQUIRED  -     Implementation/test files to create, stack dependencies (language/test framework), module rules additions, open risks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
IMPLEMENTATION_INSIGHTS    OPTIONAL  -     Optional appendix — non-trivial post-implementation learnings (library wrap patterns, transaction subtleties, fake-runtime pitfalls), added after audit-cycle compaction.
